name: Countdown
description: Counts down to a date, showing days, hours, minutes and seconds
author: Lattice

config.label: Target date
config.help: Leave empty to count down to the next January 1.

config.label: Caption
config.help: Replaces the line above the number.

sections.title: What it counts to
items: Set Target date in the inspector. The countdown runs to midnight on that day, in your local time.
Leave it empty and it counts to the next January 1 — a year still in progress is a target too.

sections.title: The caption
items: The line above the number reads Until Jan 1, 2027 by default.
Fill in Caption to replace that line with your own: Christmas, Launch day, whatever you are waiting for.
Up to 40 characters — the inspector stops there, so the line always fits the card.

sections.title: After the day arrives
items: It does not stop at zero. The number becomes days since, and the caption flips to Arrived · …
The card is marked done, so a glance is enough to see the wait is over.

sections.title: If it shows --
items: The platform did not allow reading the time. A countdown needs the clock permission to know what day it is.
An empty or unreadable target date falls back to the next January 1 rather than sitting at --.

changes: Target date and Caption moved into the inspector, so two countdowns can point at different days.
Ticks on the platform scheduler; a hidden card costs nothing.
An empty or invalid date now falls back to the next January 1 instead of showing --.
First release: days, hours, minutes and seconds to a chosen date.
Date and caption were edited on the card itself.
